name: Container Platform Onboarding
description: Comprehensive guidance for application teams transitioning to container-based platforms, covering technical transformation and organizational enablement from assessment through production operations.

narratives.name: Container Revolution Context
narratives.narrativeName: The Container Revolution and Its Challenges
narratives.description: Historical context and industry evolution of container adoption

narrativeContexts.context: Over the past decade, containerization has fundamentally transformed how organizations build, deploy, and operate software. What began as Docker's elegant solution to the 'works on my machine' problem has evolved into sophisticated orchestration platforms like Kubernetes that manage thousands of containers across global infrastructure.

However, the journey from traditional infrastructure to container platforms is fraught with complexity. Application teams accustomed to virtual machines, direct server access, and familiar deployment patterns suddenly face a steep learning curve. Organizations that rush into container adoption without structured enablement often experience frustration and failure.

The most successful container platform transformations share common characteristics. They provide clear golden paths, invest in enablement through documentation and training, establish progressive workflows starting with simple use cases, and create fast feedback loops through automated validation.

Research from DORA demonstrates that elite-performing organizations excel at platform capabilities. Teams report 60-80% reduction in time-to-first-deployment when golden paths and templates are available, and structured enablement reduces platform team toil by 40%.

activities.name: Assess Application for Containerization
activities.description: Evaluate an existing application to determine its readiness for containerization and platform deployment, examining architecture, dependencies, configuration, data management, and operational requirements.

activities.name: Build Container Image
activities.description: Create the container image that packages the application with all its dependencies, including writing the Dockerfile, optimizing for size and security, implementing health checks, and establishing automated build pipeline.

activities.name: Create Platform Deployment Manifest
activities.description: Translate the containerized application into platform-specific deployment configurations, defining how the platform should run, expose, configure, and manage the application.

activities.name: Deploy to Non-Production Environment
activities.description: Deploy the containerized application to a development or staging environment on the platform, validating that manifests work correctly, integrations function, and the team understands deployment procedures.

activities.name: Operate Containerized Application in Production
activities.description: Ongoing operational responsibilities for production containerized applications including monitoring, alert response, update deployment, scaling management, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.

activities.name: Assess Container Platform Value
activities.description: Evaluate the business value and ROI of containerizing applications, examining expected benefits against migration costs and ongoing operational overhead to prioritize onboarding efforts.
